content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The Agreement's only liability limitation (p0077, buried in the indemnity section) caps *TrueLink alone* at 12 months' hosting/support compensation and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, with a carve-out solely for TrueLink's gross negligence and wilful misconduct. Client's liability — including its very broad Section 12(a) indemnity — is entirely unlimited, which is walk-away territory and fails the fallback.

**Redline (fallback target, one surgical replace):** made the existing cap mutual and whole-of-agreement, and carved indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and wilful misconduct out of the cap, preserving the 12-month fee basis and the remainder of the sentence verbatim. Preferred items (USD 1m floor, mutual consequential-damages exclusion, payment-obligation carve-out) are noted in the rationale rather than volunteered into the edit.
